title: The Poison Master's Search for a Bride
overview: An assassin must marry to appease his clan and save his sister. Small problem: He doesn't know how to date.

title: What Is "Charm," Anyway?
overview: Kinosaki takes Gero to practice dating in a floating art museum that becomes the scene of a heist.

title: My First
overview: Gero fights a Water Master to rescue Himekawa, but his real challenge is taking her on a date afterward.

title: The Sound Master
overview: Gero goes undercover as a student to guard a corporate heiress, but he isn't the only Master on campus.

title: Lord Chladni
overview: A test of courage seems like a romantic opportunity, but it turns out to be a deadly trap.

title: Together with Me
overview: Panicked students try to sacrifice Ureshino, and stopping Naruko is the only way to make them see reason.

title: The Bug Master's Wedding
overview: Gero goes to see his friend get married, only to run into some particularly unwelcome wedding crashers.

title: The Hitman Hunter
overview: Gero takes a job to protect a fellow Master from a man who can go toe-to-toe with the expert assassins.

title: The Animal Kingdom
overview: To save Arashiyama, Gero and friends storm into the Beast Clan's home ground.

title: Good-for-Nothing
overview: Gero and Arashiyama start to bond, but a run-in with their biggest enemy ruins the mood.

title: Offering
overview: Kinosaki and Piichi sneak into a Beast Clan lab and witness bizarre experiments with blood.

title: Heart and Soul
overview: To stand a chance against the Beast Master, Gero must get in touch with the essence of his Poison Blood.

title: Thanks, Man
overview: Arashiyama throws a party to thank Gero, and Kinosaki sets out to make sure it takes a romantic turn.
